page_title: MON 1-2 BAY | B. Monchengladbach v Bayern Munich 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' Substitution. Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) on for Harry Kane.
90+3' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads it low towards the right side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and made a comfortable save.
87' 1 - 2 The score has changed – 1:2. Joshua Kimmich sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) jumps highest and plants a header inside the left post.
87' There's an opportunity for Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
85' Bayern Munich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' That will be all from Alassane Plea who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach).
83' Here is a change. Joe Scally is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach).
81' Substitution. Leon Goretzka makes his way off the pitch and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes on as his replacement.
78' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.

77' Bayern Munich show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bayern Munich are taking a throw-in.
74' The attendance for today's match is 54042.
73' Maximilian Wober is substituted due to injury. Gerardo Seoane gives a chance to Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach).
73' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Nathan Ngoumou and he is replaced by Tony Jantschke (B. Monchengladbach).
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
71' Wow, what an escape. Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
70' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas is alert and denies him.
69' Thomas Tuchel prepares a substitution. Thomas Muller is replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kingsley Coman departs the field of play to be replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
69' The shots on goal statistics – 3:5.
65' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes it short.

65' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.
63' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

63' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
62' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) picks up a long through ball, but Moritz Nicolas deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
60' Deniz Aytekin shows a yellow card to Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
59' Substitution. Tomas Cvancara did his best and is replaced by Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach).

58' 1 - 1 Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) meets a perfect cross from Joshua Kimmich deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
58' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Kingsley Coman, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
55' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

55' The ball rebounds to Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) around the penalty spot and he produces a header towards the goal. Unfortunately for him, one of the defenders prevents the ball from ending in the net.

53' Poor effort! The corner picks out Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
52' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is about to take a corner kick.
51' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
51' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.

51' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
48' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
47' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
46' Noussair Mazraoui will be replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
46' Referee Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A snap shot by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Moritz Nicolas produces a good save to thwart him.
45+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
45+2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach), but the defence gets it clear.
39' OFF THE BAR! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.

38' Joshua Kimmich pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
38' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) prepares to take a corner kick.
37' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
34' Bayern Munich fail to score from a corner as Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.

32' A sweet pass finds Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Sven Ulreich is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.

30' 1 - 0 A perfectly taken corner kick. Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the top right corner, increasing the score of today's match – 1:0.
30' B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick.

29' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.

28' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Deniz Aytekin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

26' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and glances off the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
22' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
22' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

20' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Thomas Muller and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
19' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
18' Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul after Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
17' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) plays a through ball but overhits it.
14' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
12' Bayern Munich show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.

9' Good team movement sets up Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
9' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) is penalised for a foul. Deniz Aytekin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

5' Bayern Munich are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
3' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. Bayern Munich win a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
